meaning:
πορισμός, -ου, ὁ
(πορίζω, to procure), [in LXX: Wis.13:19 14:2 * ;]
1. a providing.
2. a means of gain: 1Ti.6:5-6 (Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
